title: Timing Combat
notes: NEW COMBAT: a white ring closes in on the enemy. Press SPACE (or tap) when it meets the gold circle. PERFECT = huge damage, crystals and FLOW. Mashing makes you stumble, so spamming no longer works.
Parry is now about timing too: press right before the hit (red !), not early.
Your hero no longer attacks on their own and skills never fire automatically in Timing combat. Every hit is yours.
Legion fixed: companions now grow with your hero (they used to be far too weak and died instantly).
BUG FIX: new characters started with no weapon and armor (Simple Mode salvaged them). Fixed, and broken saves get their gear back.
Prefer the old style? Menu (Esc) > Combat style > Classic.
